newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan arrests 55 Asians for illegal entry.
newsitem.headline: Japan arrests 55 Asians for illegal entry.

text.p: Japanese police said on Tuesday they had arrested 55 men from Bangladesh, Pakistan and Iran for illegally entering the country.
Those arrested were 38 men from Bangladesh, 15 from Pakistan and two from Iran, said a police spokesman in Matsue, 600 km (380 miles) west of Tokyo.
The men told investigators they had left the South Korean port of Pusan by ship on Monday for Japan, the spokesman said.
No other details were immediately available.
Japan has voiced concern over a rise in the number of foreign nationals, mainly Chinese, trying to enter the country illegally.
In the past two months alone, nearly 400 Chinese nationals have been taken into custody for attempting to enter Japan illegally.
Last year, police reported a record 29 cases of illegal entry by groups. Of 679 people taken into custody, 545 were identified as Chinese, according to National Police Agency statistics.
